headline_marked: Andy Burnham to be [[UK's new Prime Minister]] after winning Labour leadership
headline: Andy Burnham to be UK's new Prime Minister after winning Labour leadership
summary: The new Labour leader says he has a clear plan to tackle the cost of living, reform social care, and re-industrialize the country.
details: Andy Burnham is set to become the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom after being officially elected as the leader of the Labour Party.
Speaking at the TUC headquarters in London on Friday, Burnham stated, "I know what I believe in and what I want to do in government. I have a plan."
He aims to address long-standing public dissatisfaction regarding the cost of living, public services, and regional inequality with a clear action plan.
The new government's primary goals will include reforming the social care system, decentralizing power to give regions more administrative and financial authority, and pursuing re-industrialization.
Burnham criticized the 'neo-liberal' economic policies of the last four decades, arguing they weakened the country's industrial base and increased regional disparities.
He was elected unopposed as leader after receiving support from 379 Labour MPs and 11 Labour-affiliated trade unions following the resignation of Sir Keir Starmer.
Andy Burnham is scheduled to meet King Charles III on Monday, July 20, before officially assuming the role of Prime Minister.
caption:
Andy Burnham is the UK's next Prime Minister. He says he has a plan to fix the economy and social care.

Andy Burnham is set to become the new Prime Minister of the United Kingdom after being officially elected as the leader of the Labour Party.

Speaking at the TUC headquarters in London on Friday, Burnham stated, "I know what I believe in and what I want to do in government. I have a plan."

He aims to address long-standing public dissatisfaction regarding the cost of living, public services, and regional inequality with a clear action plan.

The new government's primary goals will include reforming the social care system, decentralizing power to give regions more administrative and financial authority, and pursuing re-industrialization.

Burnham criticized the 'neo-liberal' economic policies of the last four decades, arguing they weakened the country's industrial base and increased regional disparities.

He was elected unopposed as leader after receiving support from 379 Labour MPs and 11 Labour-affiliated trade unions following the resignation of Sir Keir Starmer.

Andy Burnham is scheduled to meet King Charles III on Monday, July 20, before officially assuming the role of Prime Minister.

headline_marked: 7 cases filed: [[Police arrest Tanim Reza Bappy]] in Motijheel
headline: 7 cases filed: Police arrest Tanim Reza Bappy in Motijheel
summary: The suspect is linked to shooting incidents and extortion linked to cattle market leases in the capital's Motijheel area.
details: Motijheel police arrested Tanim Reza, alias Bappy, on Friday afternoon. He is wanted in seven different cases across various police stations.
Tanim Reza is alleged to have been involved in shooting, extortion, and working for top gangsters in the Motijheel, Moghbazar, Malibagh, and Kamalapur areas.
Police investigations revealed his involvement in a shooting incident targeting the office of Ismail Hossain, a cattle market leaseholder in South Kamalapur, before Eid-ul-Adha.
According to DC Mohammad Harun or Rashid of the DMP Motijheel division, Tanim Reza had connections with top criminals and had been evading arrest for a long time.
The suspect was finally captured during a special operation conducted by the police.
caption:
Wanted in 7 cases, a notorious suspect linked to shooting and extortion in Motijheel has been arrested.

Motijheel police arrested Tanim Reza, alias Bappy, on Friday afternoon. He is wanted in seven different cases across various police stations.

Tanim Reza is alleged to have been involved in shooting, extortion, and working for top gangsters in the Motijheel, Moghbazar, Malibagh, and Kamalapur areas.

Police investigations revealed his involvement in a shooting incident targeting the office of Ismail Hossain, a cattle market leaseholder in South Kamalapur, before Eid-ul-Adha.

According to DC Mohammad Harun or Rashid of the DMP Motijheel division, Tanim Reza had connections with top criminals and had been evading arrest for a long time.

The suspect was finally captured during a special operation conducted by the police.
